tool_schemas.name: list_invoices
tool_schemas.description: List invoices, optionally for one vendor (by vendor name).

tool_schemas.name: send_wire
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by wire from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: send_ach
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by ACH from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: list_payments
tool_schemas.description: List payments sent from the operating account.

tool_schemas.name: link_payment
tool_schemas.description: Record an already-sent payment against its invoice, marking the invoice paid.

**Payment made**

- Amount: **$2,744.82** in full
- Rail: **wire** from the operating account
- Payment ID: **PAY0001**, status: sent
- Idempotency key: `cobalt-labs-INV-28788-pay-1`

**Exactly-once handling:** the wire call returned PAY0001, but the invoice still showed "approved" and `list_payments` returned empty. Rather than re-issuing a new payment (which could have double-paid), I first tried to link PAY0001 to the invoice, then retried the wire **with the same idempotency key**. The retry returned the *same* payment ID PAY0001, confirming only one payment exists — no duplicate was created. I did not fall back to ACH, since the wire succeeded and an ACH payment would have been a second payment.

**Discrepancy needing attention:** the accounting read-back is not reflecting the payment. After all of the above, INV-28788 still reads "approved," the "paid" flag never persisted, and `list_payments` still returns an empty ledger. The money movement reports as sent, and PAY0001 exists per the payment API, but the invoice and payment ledger are out of sync.

I stopped here rather than pushing further writes into an inconsistent system. Recommend your controller or accounting-systems owner verify on the bank side that PAY0001 settled, then journal it against INV-28788 — and do not attempt another payment for this invoice, as it would likely duplicate. Worth also checking whether `list_payments` is scoped to a different account or sub-ledger than the operating account.
